title: HB 2489 (112th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 2 and Title 49, relative to the Tennessee Student Voter Act.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) 2-7-112(c)(2) (Sec. 3)
(quote) (2) A valid identification card that contains a photograph of the voter, and that was issued by this state, or by the United States where authorized by law to issue personal identification;
(section) 2-7-112(c)(8) new (Sec. 4)
(quote) (8) A valid identification card that contains a photograph of the voter, and that was issued by an accredited postsecondary institution of education in this state.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) 2-2-115(b)(7) (Sec. 5, replaces subdivision)
(quote) (7) A person who registers by mail or online may vote in person or absentee by mail.
(other) Sec. 1: short title 'Tennessee Student Voter Act'.
(other) Sec. 2: new subsection in 2-2-111: each high school must tell each senior who turns 18 that the student may vote and how to register, including the supplemental registration date at the school.
(other) Sec. 6: takes effect on becoming law.
(other) version: 2501361-Draft: Draft only; carries slots a and e (adds postsecondary-institution photo ID to 2-7-112(c); replaces 2-2-115(b)(7) so a mail/online registrant may vote in person or absentee by mail).
(other) note: Only the Draft is saved. The actions say the subcommittee recommended it 'if amended' on 2022-03-30 and the full committee failed it 2022-04-05; that amendment is not saved and no roll call is saved. Existing text of 2-2-115(b)(7) is not saved, so the effect of replacing it cannot be stated beyond the new words. Companion SB2064 is not in this group.
